title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - ProductionEquipmentCategory
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/ProductionEquipmentCategory . Represents a certain category of production equipment, generally static over time: concretely, a certain model and brand of production equipment. Each ProductionEquipmentCategory can have multiple related ProductionEquipment instances (the actual individual machines), and each ItemCategory can be produced by multiple ProductionEquipmentCategories.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ProductionEquipmentCategory'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasName.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasName' (reused from SAREF core). The name of this production equipment category (at most one).

hasModelNumber.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/hasModelNumber'. The model number of this production equipment category (at most one).

hasManufacturer.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasManufacturer' (reused from SAREF core). The manufacturer of this production equipment category (at most one).

isCategoryOf.description: Relationship. The individual production equipment instances belonging to this category (inverse of ProductionEquipment's belongsToCategory). Target model: 'ProductionEquipment'.

produces.description: Relationship. The item categories produced using this production equipment category (inverse of ItemCategory's isProducedBy), e.g. welding machines or laser cutting machines producing certain categories of items. Target model: 'ItemCategory'.
